title: 第一章 重生至末日两小时前
slug: 重生末日最强生存系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

教室内，老师的声音响起：“林夕！你又在睡觉！”随后一个粉笔头向着林夕扔来...

林夕猛地睁开眼睛，下意识的接住了高速飞来的粉笔，全班同学都发出惊讶的声音

就连老师都感到有一丝惊讶，林夕看着手中的粉笔，又看了看熟悉的教室以及同学

脑袋一阵迷糊，心中想到：“我不是被推进丧尸群里了吗，怎么会在这里。”

“林夕，你站起来！”台上的年轻老师冲着林夕喊道

林夕摸了摸脑袋站了起来，耳边老师的训诫声不断传来

但是林夕却丝毫没有听进去，林夕努力的回想着一切

三年前的今天，也就是丧尸爆发的日子

林夕猛地看向墙上挂着的表，已经9点20了也就是说再过两个半小时，整个世界将会大变样

不知名病毒迅速席卷整个世界，整个世界在一瞬间崩溃，病毒不是全面感染，后期统计的数据是

感染的人数和未感染的人数大致是五五分，也就是说在那一瞬间，病毒就将地球上的一半生命，变成了丧失一样的物种，具体是什么原因，林夕作为一个苟且偷生了三年勉勉强强获得了一个C级能力者的人来说太过遥远，当然，除了丧尸，有一些人类，也觉醒了自己的能力，有的是力量，有的是精神，总之千奇百怪的能力，有些人是第一时间便觉醒了能力，而有些人则是通过后期的改造成的能力者

当然林夕就是那个后期改造的能力者。

林夕回想着一切，叮铃铃，下课的闹钟响了起来。

讲台上的年轻老师看了看林夕叹了口气，没有说什么，对着同学们说了一声下课，就走出了教室

Page (1/3)

In the classroom, the teacher's voice sounded: "Lin Xi! You are sleeping again!" Then a piece of chalk was thrown at Lin Xi...

Lin Xi opened her eyes suddenly and subconsciously caught the chalk flying at high speed. The whole class made a sound of surprise.

Even the teacher was a little surprised. Lin Xi looked at the chalk in her hand, then looked at the familiar classroom and classmates.

My head was confused for a while, and I thought in my mind: "Didn't I get pushed into the zombie group? Why am I here?"

"Lin Xi, stand up!" the young teacher on the stage shouted to Lin Xi

Lin Xi touched her head and stood up. The teacher's admonitions kept coming to her ears.

But Lin Xi didn't listen at all. Lin Xi tried hard to recall everything.

Three years ago today, the day the zombies broke out

Lin Xi suddenly looked at the clock hanging on the wall. It was already 9:20, which meant that in two and a half hours, the whole world would be completely different.

The unknown virus quickly swept the entire world, and the whole world collapsed in an instant. The virus was not a comprehensive infection. Later statistical data was

The number of people infected and the number of uninfected people was roughly 50-50. In other words, in that instant, the virus turned half of the life on earth into a lost species. For what specific reasons, Lin Xi barely managed to obtain a C-level ability user after living in idly condition for three years.It is too far away for people. Of course, in addition to zombies, some humans have also awakened their own abilities. Some are strength, some are spiritual. In short, there are all kinds of strange abilities. Some people awaken their abilities immediately, while some people become ability users through later transformation.

Of course Lin Xi is the ability user who was transformed later.

Lin Xi thought about everything, and the alarm clock rang for the end of get out of class.

The young teacher on the podium looked at Lin Xi and sighed without saying anything. He told his classmates that get out of class was over and walked out of the classroom.
